Figure 2: Overview of the proposed CoMSMark framework. The encoder generates screen-specific residuals from the watermark and screen ID, which are added to cover images and processed by a screen-shooting noise layer. A dual-head decoder jointly recovers the watermark and screen ID. The collusion suppression loss reduces shared residual patterns and constructs forged samples during training to enhance resistance to multi-screen collusion attacks.
